info.title: MICROSERVICE-batchinsertion-List Meetings Meetings Notes-v4-spec
info.description: The Meeting Notes Retrieval API provides functionality to access and review notes associated with scheduled meetings. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of notes for specific meetings, facilitating better planning and collaboration. Typical consumers of this API include project managers, team leads, and administrative staff who need to ensure critical meeting insights are documented and easily accessible. By leveraging this API, teams can enhance their communication and decision-making processes based on accurate meeting records.

get.description: Fetches a list of notes associated with meetings. This endpoint allows users to view notes that have been recorded for scheduled meetings, enabling effective collaboration and reference.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving meeting notes. This body holds the necessary parameters to specify the details of the meeting for which notes are being requested.

ListMeetingsMeetingsNotesRequest.description: A string representing the request body for the Operations GET request for meetings notes.
